### Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation Announces Date for Q3 2026 Earnings Release


October 13, 2026


**BEDMINSTER, N.J., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: PGC), the holding company for Peapack Private Bank & Trust, is scheduled to release Q3 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, after the market close. The Company will host a conference call to review its third quarter results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (ET).


Listeners may access the live webcast at[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/855592172](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=K2f538Ifgn2NkM3GVLqJB_QGbQ8xzxcK-hbJGo-wIUThpdCoI_CFHiJsERjh76Sphw6nsWBcMMkWZq1ovNACqez-i3L4ouuKY2nboig8I9vmaIpmNV8YjjllqNTFmz7t7SJfwS5OW7a4obY9HIgkYnpt6SOy_JecVsctAdv9Lhw=) or join the toll-free teleconference by dialing 1-833-461-5787 and entering access code 134 224 446. A replay and all conference details will be available in the Events & Presentations section of the Company’s investor relations website at[https://peapackprivate.q4ir.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=K2f538Ifgn2NkM3GVLqJB_a68jKx1hAlWmSfaSaLxOm2LuV7RPu1tRN7YVN0TdQfJeAcyJs0-Jk8mCPAoYe_Jo5LuXH82TLBJCznvUxZL3KWgCclJ28k0UF60fmhgAEp) .


**About the Company**


Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation is a New Jersey bank holding company with total assets of $8.0 billion and assets under management and/or administration of $13.9 billion as of June 30, 2026. Founded in 1921, Peapack Private Bank & Trust is a commercial bank that offers a client-centric approach to banking, providing high-quality products along with customized and innovative wealth management, investment banking, commercial and personal banking solutions. The Bank's wealth management division offers comprehensive financial, tax, fiduciary and investment advice and solutions to individuals, families, privately held businesses, family offices, and not-for-profit organizations, which help them establish, maintain, and expand their legacy. Peapack Private Bank & Trust offers an unparalleled commitment to client service. Visit www.peapackprivate.com for more information.
